name: Pulin Behari Das
contribution: Pulin Behari Das was the founder-president and principal organizer of the Dhaka Anushilan Samiti, established in 1906 as a militant anti-colonial organization rooted in the Swadeshi-era politics of eastern Bengal.
context: After the 1905 Partition of Bengal, Das helped organize young men through physical training, secret association, and revolutionary discipline. The Dhaka branch developed a wide network across eastern Bengal, placing it within the broader contest between colonial surveillance, constitutional politics, boycott, and armed resistance.
impact: Das helped make Dhaka a major center of revolutionary organization, but the movement's growth also brought repression, arrests, detention, and fragmentation. His legacy belongs to the eastern Bengal strand of militant anti-colonial politics; the later 1930 Chittagong Armoury Raid is included as lineage and memory context, not as an action he personally led.
highlight: Founder-president of the Dhaka Anushilan Samiti and a major organizer of revolutionary politics in eastern Bengal.
seoTitle: Pulin Behari Das: Dhaka Anushilan Revolutionary Organizer
seoDescription: Learn about Pulin Behari Das (1877–1949), founder-president of the Dhaka Anushilan Samiti and a leading organizer of Swadeshi-era revolutionary politics in eastern Bengal.
shortAnswer: Pulin Behari Das was the founder-president of the Dhaka Anushilan Samiti, a revolutionary organization formed in 1906 during the Swadeshi movement in eastern Bengal.
searchAliases: Pulin Behari Das Dhaka Anushilan Samiti

faq.question: Who was Pulin Behari Das?
faq.answer: Pulin Behari Das was a Bengali revolutionary who founded and led the Dhaka Anushilan Samiti, an organization formed in 1906 during the anti-colonial Swadeshi period.

faq.question: Did Pulin Behari Das lead the 1930 Chittagong Armoury Raid?
faq.answer: No. The 1930 raid was led by Surya Sen. Das's connection to that event is best treated as revolutionary-lineage and memory context rather than direct participation.
